rawContent: Here’s what I find unlawful following the #GeorgeFloydMurder, criminalizing the #GeorgeFloydProtests. How is #BeingBlack a crime punishable by death? Last time I checked, it never has been. #BlackLivesMatter should mean something; that Black lives are never expendable. #jgsf1987

But the fact that #WhiteSupremacy has become more pervasive there is a very real problem that #BlackLivesMatter has pointed out time and time again. It’s sickening to know that the #WhiteSupremacistInChief has done more to promote this ghastly ideology

I support the #GeorgeFloydProtestors 100%, as they’re doing us a public service by providing a human face to the #BlackLivesMatter movement and to the real problem of unaccountability of law enforcement officers whenever a Black man or boy is killed by them. I just hope they do..
It’s good to see the protestors from #BlackLivesMatter out in the streets. I should try to get in touch with the closest local chapter.

The reason that #BlackLivesMatter is the lack of voice for Black Americans on an historic basis. Blacks up until about 60 years ago had no means of demanding dignity, respect, and a level playing field from White Americans; that they will never accept being second-class citizens.

The other officers who accompanied #DerekChauvin, should they face charges, should be charged with being accessories in the #GeorgeFloydMurder. #GeorgeFloyd’s death should be used as a rallying cry for #BlackLivesMatter, because most Black deaths from police can be prevented.
An assessment of what the #GeorgeFloydMurder protests’ true meaning and how it affects #RaceInAmerica. #jgsf1987 #GeorgeFloyd #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/VZNqaG18J3

I have to commend @MittRomney for joining in the #BlackLivesMatter march in Washington, DC. Hopefully some of his @SenateGOP colleagues can take a hint that it's time to stand up for social justice and police reform.
